paragraphs.en: Dorothy spent several happy weeks in Oz as a guest of Princess Ozma. She made new friends and reconnected with old ones wherever she went. One day, while sitting in Ozma's private room, Dorothy noticed a magical picture on the wall that constantly changed scenes.
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西在奥兹国公主奥兹玛的客人身份中度过了几个愉快的星期。她在 wherever她去的地方都结识了新朋友，也与老朋友重逢。一天，在奥兹玛的私人房间里坐着的时候，多萝西注意到墙上挂着一幅 constantly 变换场景的魔法画。

paragraphs.en: "Very curious!" she exclaimed after watching for a few moments.
paragraphs.zh: “真够奇怪的！”她看了一会儿后不禁脱口而出。

paragraphs.en: "Yes," said Ozma, "it’s a wonderful invention. Just express your wish, and it will appear."
paragraphs.zh: 奥兹玛说道：“是的，这是一项奇妙的发明。只要表达你的愿望，它就会出现。”

paragraphs.en: Dorothy eagerly asked to see her old Kansas farm and Aunt Em. Instantly, the familiar farmhouse appeared in the picture. Aunt Em was washing dishes by the window, looking well and contented.
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西急切地请求看看她旧日的堪萨斯农场和阿姨艾姆。画面瞬间出现了那熟悉的农舍。艾姆正靠窗洗着碗碟，看上去健康而满足。

paragraphs.en: The hired men and teams were busy in the fields behind the house, and Dorothy saw Toto sleeping on the porch. To her surprise, she spotted Speckles with a brood of twelve new chickens.
paragraphs.zh: 房后的田地里，雇工们忙碌不停，而多萝西看到托托正躺在门廊上睡觉。令她惊讶的是，她还发现了斯佩克尔斯带着一窝十二只新鸡。

paragraphs.en: "Everything seems fine at home," said Dorothy, relieved. "Now I wonder about Uncle Henry."
paragraphs.zh: “家里一切似乎都很正常，”多萝西松了一口气说，“现在我倒是担心起亨利叔叔了。”

paragraphs.en: The picture shifted to Australia, where Uncle Henry was seated in Sydney, smoking his pipe sadly and looking thin and worried. Dorothy felt anxious and decided to seek help from Glinda the Good.
paragraphs.zh: 画面切换到了澳大利亚，亨利叔叔正坐在悉尼，抽着烟斗，神情忧郁而消瘦。多萝西感到焦虑不安，决定向好巫女Glinda求助。

paragraphs.en: Ozma agreed, and they rode away in a green and pink phaeton pulled by the Sawhorse. Upon arriving at Glinda's castle, Dorothy told her story. With the magic belt, she hoped for guidance on how to reach Uncle Henry.
paragraphs.zh: 奥兹玛同意了，于是她们乘坐一辆绿色和粉色的双轮马车，由木马拉行，前往格琳达的城堡。到达后，多萝西讲述了她的故事，并希望能借助魔法腰带得到指引，以便找到亨利叔叔。

paragraphs.en: Dorothy buckled her magic belt around her waist and asked Glinda if it could take her to Uncle Henry. Glinda confirmed its magical powers were only active in fairy countries like Oz or Ev. Dorothy then proposed giving the belt to Princess Ozma, who could use it safely within her own realm.
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西将魔法腰带系在腰部，问格琳达能否用它把她送到亨利叔叔那里。格琳达确认，这种魔力只在奥兹国或埃夫国这样的仙境里生效。接着，多萝西提议把腰带给奥兹玛公主，让她在自己的领地内安全使用。

paragraphs.en: Glinda agreed this was a wise plan. They returned to the Emerald City where they arranged for Ozma to check on Dorothy via magic picture every Saturday morning. If Dorothy signaled, Ozma would wish her back using the Nome King's belt.
paragraphs.zh: 格琳达认为这是一个明智的计划。他们返回了翡翠城，在那里安排奥兹玛每周六早上通过魔法画面检查多萝西的情况。如果多萝西发出信号，奥兹玛将使用 Nome 王国国王的腰带把她送回来。

paragraphs.en: After saying goodbye, Dorothy left Tiktok with Ozma since he wouldn't fit in a civilized country and his machinery might not work. Billina stayed behind, preferring the Land of Oz to any other place. She argued that the bugs and ants here were the best she had ever tasted.
paragraphs.zh: 告别后，多萝西带着奥兹玛离开了蒂克托克，因为奥兹玛不适合文明国家，而且他的机械装置可能无法正常运行。比琳达则选择留在原地，她更喜欢奥兹国胜过任何其他地方。她争辩说，这里的小虫子和蚂蚁是她尝过的最好吃的。

paragraphs.en: Dorothy insisted on returning to Uncle Henry, believing it was her duty. Everyone except Billina thought this was right. All Dorothy's friends from Oz—both old and new—gathered to see her off.
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西坚持要回到亨利叔叔那里，认为这是她的职责所在。除了比琳娜之外，大家都觉得这样做是对的。奥兹国的老朋友和新朋友们纷纷聚集起来为她送行。

paragraphs.en: Dorothy stood before Princess Ozma with her friends, bidding a tearful farewell. She hugged each one—Ozma, the Scarecrow, Tin Woodman, Cowardly Lion, and Tiktok—and then handed Ozma the Nome King's magic belt.
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西站在奥兹玛公主面前，与朋友们依依惜别，眼中含着泪水。她一一拥抱了每一个人——奥兹玛、稻草人、铁皮人、胆小狮和钛拓克（Tiktok），然后将 Nome 王的魔法腰带交给了奥兹玛。

paragraphs.en: "Dear Princess," Dorothy said, "when I wave my handkerchief, please wish me well with Uncle Henry. I'm so sorry to leave you all, but I miss him terribly. Goodbye."
paragraphs.zh: “亲爱的公主，”多萝西说，“当我挥动手帕时，请为我向亨利叔叔问好。我很抱歉要离开你们大家，但我非常想念他。再见了。”

paragraphs.en: She stood on a large emerald in the courtyard and waved her handkerchief.
paragraphs.zh: 她站在庭院中一块巨大的祖母绿上，挥动着手帕。

paragraphs.en: Dorothy then returned to Uncle Henry's side, promising to nurse him back to health. "I wasn't drowned," she said, "and I'm here to take care of you as soon as possible." Uncle Henry smiled, hugging his niece tightly.
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西回到亨利叔叔身边，承诺要照料他早日康复。“我没有被淹死，”她说，“我会尽快来照顾你。”亨利叔叔微笑着紧紧拥抱了她。

paragraphs.en: "I feel much better already, my darling," he replied.
paragraphs.zh: “我已经感觉好很多了，我的宝贝。”他说道。
